solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Very thin peer given gum

parts.note: a peer is an equal, someone who is a match for you
to gum something is to make it stick

explanation.surface: A gaunt aristocrat is handed some chewing gum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Peer' suggests a lord, but here it means an equal.
explanation.definitionFit: Used adjectivally, as in 'matchstick limbs', the word describes something extremely thin.

clue.text: French painter trimmed long hair

indicators.note: trimmed means the painter's name has its final letter cut off

parts.note: Edouard Manet was a French Impressionist painter

explanation.surface: An artist from France gets a haircut, losing his flowing locks.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse's or lion's long neck hair is its mane, and by extension a person's thick long hair.

clue.text: Make it fly

parts.note: the moment an aircraft leaves the ground is what gets it into the air

explanation.definitionFit: Leaving the runway is the act that gets a plane airborne, the start of flight.

clue.text: Stall close to Spanish border

indicators.note: close to points at the end letter of the word Spanish

parts.note: a border is an edge

explanation.surface: A market stall stands near the frontier with Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stall' reads as a noun, a booth; it is the verb, to stall or evade.
explanation.definitionFit: To hedge is to avoid committing oneself, playing for time, which is what stalling means.

clue.text: Sauce boat cracked when curry initially poured in

indicators.note: poured in means that letter is put inside the rearranged letters
cracked means the letters of boat and the short word are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the word curry

explanation.surface: A gravy boat breaks when curry is poured into it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sauce boat' looks like one dish for gravy, but 'Sauce' alone is the definition; 'cracked' gives TABO, which the rest goes into.
explanation.definitionFit: Tabasco is a brand of hot pepper sauce from Louisiana.

clue.text: Hidden tomb, under which one's cold

indicators.note: in a down answer, the pieces that follow sit underneath the tomb word

parts.note: a crypt is an underground burial chamber
one is the Roman numeral I
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: A tomb lies hidden, and someone beneath it feels a chill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hidden' looks like an adjective describing the tomb, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something cryptic is obscure or secret in meaning, concealed from plain view.

clue.text: Married? He's crazy to become engaged!

indicators.note: crazy means the letters of he's are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a man is married, calling him mad to get engaged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'engaged' suggests betrothal; it is meant as gears engaging.
explanation.definitionFit: Gear teeth that interlock are said to mesh, which is the mechanical sense of becoming engaged.

clue.text: Recipient of product sold ensured special delivery

indicators.note: delivery made special suggests the word ensured is handed over in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A customer who bought the goods was guaranteed express postage.
explanation.definitionFit: The final consumer of a product, rather than a reseller, is called its end-user.

clue.text: Bad luck coming across resistance from uncompromising types

indicators.note: coming across means the sympathy phrase spans round the resistance letter

parts.note: hard lines is a British expression of sympathy meaning bad luck
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: Unfortunately, stubborn people put up opposition.
explanation.walkthrough: HARD LINES is an old-fashioned British way of saying 'bad luck!'.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardliners are people who stick rigidly to a policy and refuse to compromise.

clue.text: Adore material supplied by Cavalier poet

parts.note: to adore is to love
lace is a delicate fabric

explanation.surface: A Royalist poet offers fabric to someone he adores.
explanation.walkthrough: The Cavalier poets were 17th-century English poets who supported King Charles I.
explanation.definitionFit: Richard Lovelace was one of the English Cavalier poets, writer of 'To Althea, from Prison'.

clue.text: Exposed, a king in retreat heading west

indicators.note: in places the article and the king letter inside the turned word
in an across clue heading west means the retreat word is read right to left

parts.note: a den is a private retreat
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A monarch is laid bare while fleeing westwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading west' turns DEN into NED, and A and K go inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Naked means bare or uncovered, so it is a synonym of exposed.

clue.text: One byword abroad for an extremely talented young man

indicators.note: abroad, in the sense of scattered widely, signals rearranging one byword

explanation.surface: A single word used everywhere for a gifted youth.
explanation.definitionFit: A boy wonder is a remarkably gifted youngster, a prodigy.

clue.text: County set eating pigeons hotel left out

indicators.note: eating means the set word takes the pigeon word inside it

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: left out means the hotel letter is dropped

parts.note: homers are homing pigeons
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A group of people in a county eat pigeons, leaving the hotel out of it.
explanation.walkthrough: SOMERSET is a county in south-west England; 'pigeons' as HOMERS relies on homing pigeons being called homers.
explanation.definitionFit: Somerset is one of the counties of England, in the West Country.

clue.text: Stand in calm lake

parts.note: to ease is to calm or soothe
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: An instruction to stand still in a tranquil lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stand' looks like a verb; it is the noun, a frame for holding a painting.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's easel is a stand or frame that holds a canvas while painting.

clue.text: Captain supporting call for MC

indicators.note: in a down answer the supporting piece sits beneath the other

parts.note: to ring is to call on the telephone
a master is the captain of a merchant ship

explanation.surface: The ship's captain backs a vote for the master of ceremonies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supporting' puts MASTER below RING in the down light.
explanation.definitionFit: In a circus the ringmaster introduces the acts, acting as master of ceremonies.

clue.text: Fire out of control around North? No, a conflagration

indicators.note: around means the rearranged letters wrap round the north letter
out of control means the letters of fire run wild into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A blaze rages in the north: is it a huge fire?
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of control' turns FIRE into IFER, and 'around' puts N inside it after the I.
explanation.definitionFit: An inferno is a large, fiercely burning fire, just as a conflagration is.

clue.text: Kept back, being shy

definitions.meaning: booked or held aside for someone, like a table
describing a person who is reticent and keeps to themselves

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a seat set aside for later and a quiet, undemonstrative personality.

clue.text: Greek in series causes annoyance

indicators.note: in places the Greek abbreviation inside the series word

parts.note: a chain is a series of linked events

explanation.surface: A Greek person in a TV series is a source of irritation.
explanation.definitionFit: Chagrin is vexation or mortification at having failed or been humiliated.

clue.text: Excited seeing Sterne's first book

indicators.note: excited means the letters of seeing are stirred up
first picks the opening letter of the novelist's name

explanation.surface: Thrilled at spotting the novelist Laurence Sterne's debut work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'book' tempts as a novel by Sterne; it is the first book of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Genesis is the first book of the Old Testament.

clue.text: Everyday occasion, ultimately, at Russian river

indicators.note: ultimately picks the final letter of occasion

parts.note: taken as written
the Ural is a river flowing through Russia and Kazakhstan

explanation.surface: A routine event, in the end, by a river in Russia.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural can mean ordinary or normal, as everyday behaviour is.

clue.text: Help for victim? Sounds like it

indicators.note: sounds like it signals the victim word heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a sucker is a gullible person, an easy victim

explanation.surface: Is assistance offered to the dupe? It seems so.
explanation.definitionFit: Succour is aid given to someone in distress, so it is a synonym of help.

clue.text: Conservative, one departing in a chopper

parts.note: a leaver is someone who leaves

explanation.surface: A Tory politician quits in a helicopter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chopper' suggests a helicopter; it is the butcher's knife.
explanation.definitionFit: A cleaver is a heavy chopping knife used by butchers.

clue.text: Business interest

definitions.meaning: something that matters to you or involves you

explanation.definitionFit: The word serves both as a commercial firm and as a matter in which one has a stake.

clue.text: Taken in by advert, I google film

indicators.note: taken in by means the letters lie within the words advert, I google

explanation.surface: Fooled by an advertisement, I search online for a movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Vertigo is Alfred Hitchcock's 1958 thriller starring James Stewart.

clue.text: Flower expert losing face

indicators.note: losing face means the expert word drops its front letter

parts.note: a master is an expert

explanation.surface: An expert gardener is humiliated over a bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: The aster is a daisy-like garden flower, the Michaelmas daisy among them.

clue.text: Scheme to mislead summit

parts.note: to con is to deceive or mislead
a spire is a tapering peak or summit

explanation.surface: A plot to deceive people at a high-level meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'summit' looks like a meeting of leaders; it means a pointed top.
explanation.definitionFit: To conspire is to plot or scheme secretly with others.

clue.text: Soft, every single fruit

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for soft
each means every single one

explanation.surface: Every one of the fruits is soft and ripe.
explanation.definitionFit: A peach is a soft, downy stone fruit.

clue.text: Ring sandpiper

definitions.meaning: a loop or tied circle of rope or cord
a wading bird of the sandpiper family

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a tied loop in a rope and a small wading shorebird.

clue.text: Blind mice, perhaps to her, seem unsettling

indicators.note: unsettling means the letters of to her seem are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: Sightless mice may appear disturbing to a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The nursery rhyme 'Three Blind Mice' makes them a group of three.
explanation.definitionFit: The three blind mice of the nursery rhyme are a group of three, an example of a trio.

clue.text: Strange invention covered by article

indicators.note: covered by means the invention word sits inside the article

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
a lie is an invention, a made-up story

explanation.surface: An odd fabrication appears under a newspaper piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'article' suggests a newspaper piece; it is the grammatical article.
explanation.definitionFit: Alien can mean unfamiliar or foreign, so it serves as a synonym of strange.

clue.text: Function of burger bun, it's said

indicators.note: it's said signals the bun word heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a bread roll is the bun a burger comes in

explanation.surface: What a hamburger bun is for, so people say.
explanation.definitionFit: A role is a function or part someone or something plays.

clue.text: Technocrat ordered outdoor garment

indicators.note: ordered means the letters of technocrat are put in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A technical expert requests a coat for wearing outside.
explanation.definitionFit: A trench coat is a belted, double-breasted raincoat worn outdoors.
